### OpenRegister reliance

**light**: this component touches OpenRegister lightly. 2 direct references, 1 file reached through imports.

See the [reliance overview](./index.md#openregister-reliance) for the filterable list.

| Name           | Type      | Required | Default                         | Description                                                                                                                           |
| -------------- | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `job`          | `object`  | ✓        | —                               | The job as last read: `{ id, state, processed, total, counts: { applied, skipped, refused, failed } }`. The host owns the first read. |
| `busy`         | `boolean` |          | `false`                         | Whether the host is mid-request and the buttons should wait.                                                                          |
| `source`       | `string`  |          | `'openregister'`                | `'openregister'` follows an OpenRegister bulk job; `'local'` draws a run the host drives.                                             |
| `rows`         | `array`   |          | `[]`                            | The rows of a `local` run: `{ id, label?, outcome, reason? }`, where `outcome` is applied, skipped, refused or failed.                |
| `outcomes`     | `array`   |          | `() =&gt; ALL_OUTCOMES.slice()` | The outcomes offered, in order. A run that cannot refuse leaves `refused` out.                                                        |
| `labels`       | `object`  |          | `\{\}`                          | Templates replacing the library wording, keyed as in the docs.                                                                        |
| `downloadUrl`  | `string`  |          | `''`                            | Where the report downloads from; defaults to the OpenRegister report of an `openregister` job.                                        |
| `pollInterval` | `number`  |          | `2000`                          | How often a running job is re-read, in ms.                                                                                            |
| `pageSize`     | `number`  |          | `25`                            | How many rows one page of an outcome list holds.                                                                                      |
